hints.text: A statistical question needs variability. Ask whether anyone could correctly give a different answer here.
The sum $2 + 2$ is a fixed arithmetic fact. Everyone who works it out gets the same number, so no data needs collecting.
The answer is no, because the question has exactly one answer.

explanation: A statistical question is answered by collecting data that varies.
The sum $2 + 2$ always equals $4$, so every correct response is the same.
There is no variability in the answers, so no, it is not a statistical question.
